limitations: The datasets verify Paladin A1 full-animation frame counts for listed weapons and IAS ranges only.
They do not verify A2 runtime selection, hit-registration timing, repeated-input gameplay cadence, or skill/buff IAS.
War Hammer is verified only through IAS 317, the upper threshold published in the reference table; IAS 318 and above are outside this dataset.
Crystal Sword's weapons.txt speed field is blank; its existing WSM 0 resolution is retained from the prior validation.
